newsitem.title: USA: Proxima sees lower gross margin percentage.
newsitem.headline: Proxima sees lower gross margin percentage.

text.p: Proxima Corp said it expects price competition for its multimedia projectors to intensify and its gross margin percentage to trend lower than the third quarter's 29 percent.

Proxima Monday reported net income of $1,838,000, or $0.25 cents per share, for the three months ended December 31, 1996, compared with net income of $3,229,000, or $0.46 cents per share, in the same period last year.
Revenue for the third quarter of fiscal 1997 increased to $47,365,000 from $44,216,000 in the third quarter of fiscal 1996.
